pattern_explanation: Each Ukrainian word here looks similar to an English word but has a different meaning, so the similarity in form misleads learners.
false_friend_warning: Students may read the Ukrainian word 'mahazyn' as English 'magazine', but it means 'shop'; 'aktualnyi' looks like 'actual' but means 'relevant'; and 'konkurs' looks like 'concourse' but means 'competition'.
